issue.body:
# APP-CHAIN: chain home and 14-day history at `/app` **Epic:** RunTag App v1 (PRDs/runtag-app-prd.md @ f6c230c7…) · **Wave:** W2 · **Priority:** P0 · **Depends on:** APP-SHELL #26 (merged, live), APP-TAP #27 (merged, live: `abandonStaleIn`, `isStale`, `stale-notice`) **Persona:** owner-runner (iPhone 13 class, 390 px wide) · **Promise:** "Open the app and see one number that matters, and the days behind it." **Gate A:** SHIP_WITH_STIPULATIONS — verdict §7 APP-CHAIN items 1–3 (S-11, T12, M-3) folded. **B.5:** docs/specs/app/APP-CHAIN-preflight.md — P1-1…P1-9, P2-1…P2-9 folded (v2). **Pinned hops:** I1, I13, A13, A14; shared-contract hops S3, S7, S8.3 (PRDs/runtag-app-hops.md, amendment 2026-10-14). **Covers:** APP-006 (on `/app` render), APP-007, APP-008, APP-009 ## Scope ### In scope Replace the APP-SHELL placeholder home view (`components/app/views/home.tsx`) with the real chain home: chain number, capped chain visual, 14-day history, at-risk state, open-run banner and stale notice (with stale abandon on render), empty state, an empty `backup-status` slot. Keep, unchanged: ``, ``, the `store-error` view (`StoreError.kind` text), and the mount effect that posts `{type:'SKIP_WAITING'}` to `reg.waiting` and reloads once on `controllerchange` (P1-8). ### Not in scope Tap logic and `/app?tapped=` / `/app?grace=` views (APP-TAP #27, unchanged), backup status/nudge content (APP-DURABLE #18 — this ticket renders the empty `backup-status` slot only), tag management (APP-TAGS #17). ## Rules - **Load (P2-1):** on mount, home captures `now = Date.now()` once and calls `withTxn('readwrite', async s => { await abandonStaleIn(s, now); return { runs: getAll(runs), tags: getAll(tags) } })`. Everything rendered derives from that one result and `today = localDayOf(now)` (the device's current local date — S-11). Home starts no other store transaction. A rejected transaction renders the existing `store-error` view. - **Day change (P2-6):** home re-runs the load on `visibilitychange` to `visible` when `localDayOf(Date.now())` differs from the rendered `today` (manual check in the APP-LINK device list). - **Chain:** `chain = computeChain(runs, today)` from APP-SHELL; never `CHAIN.*` demo constants; no app identifier named `chainCount` (M-3, INV-D3). `chain-value` text = `String(chain)`, inside `

Chain {chain} days

` as the accessible statement (P2-9). - **Chain visual (T12, P1-3, P2-2):** `` inside a wrapper with `aria-hidden="true"` (default `highlightLast={false}`; no change to components/ChainVisual.tsx, which the demo shares). `chain-visual` `data-count` = `min(chain, 30)` (links rendered). Long chains never render more than 30 links, and the view never scrolls horizontally. - **History (P1-1, P1-2):** `buildHistory(runs, today)` in `lib/app/history.ts` (pure) returns the 14 days `today−13 … today`, oldest → newest. Days are enumerated only by repeated `previousDay(today)`, never by subtracting milliseconds from `now`. Let `first` = the minimum `localDay` over runs with `status:'done'` and `localDay ≤ today` (undefined if none). For each day `d`: `done` iff some `done` run has `localDay === d`; otherwise, if `d === today`, `today-pending`; otherwise, if `first` is undefined or `d < first`, `neutral`; otherwise `missed`. Open and abandoned runs never make a day `done`. Done runs with `localDay > today` are ignored. Today is never `neutral` or `missed`. - **History labels (P2-3, P2-9):** each `history-day` (`data-day`, `data-state`) shows a weekday abbreviation from `Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { weekday: 'short', timeZone: 'UTC' })` applied to `Date.UTC(y, m−1, d)` parsed from `data-day`; it never shows single-letter initials or a bare day number. Its accessible name is `aria-label="{weekday long} {day} {month long}: {state text}"` (same formatter, `timeZone: 'UTC'`), state text Ran / Missed / Not yet / empty for neutral; states are distinguished by text/label and shape, not colour alone. - **At risk (P2-5):** `data-testid="at-risk"` with "Run today to keep your chain." iff yesterday's history state is `done` and today has no done run. An open run today does not hide it. - **Open run banner:** after the load, a remaining open run shows `data-testid="open-run-banner"` "Run in progress — tap your tag to finish". Stale runs never show and never count (APP-006). - **Stale notice (P1-7):** when some run has `0 ≤ now − abandonedAt < 60_000` (the APP-TAP derivation), home shows `

Your last run wasn't tapped out, so it didn't count.

` — covers runs abandoned by this render or by a tap within the last minute. - **Empty state (P1-4):** `data-testid="empty-state"` when there are no tags and no runs. It renders in addition to the chain block (`chain-value` 0, `ChainVisual count={0}`) and the history. Copy: heading "Plant your first tag", then "Stick a tag where you start running, then plant it here." A link "Plant a tag" (`data-testid="empty-plant-link"`, `href="/app/tags"`) navigates with `shellNavigate` like AppNav. - **Backup slot:** an empty `
` for APP-DURABLE. - No metrics, clock times or durations in rendered text (APP-008). ## Contract (P2-7) `docs/contracts/feature_app.yml` gains rule **APP-CHAIN-SOURCE** (non_negotiable; additive, no existing rule changed): scope `components/app/**/*.{ts,tsx}`, `lib/app/**/*.ts`; forbidden `/(?.json` passes `scripts/provenance-gate.cjs` on the branch diff - [ ] production code < 1000 hand-written lines (owner amendment 2026-10-13: tests and contracts excluded) - [ ] `bash evidence/seams-check.sh evidence/seams-app-chain.json` exits 0 after build
